text: きみは　ポケモン　もってるな？

structure.jp: ポケモン　もってるな？

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: て plus いる after a verb says a state is going on now; てる is the short spoken form. もってる = 'have'.

patterns.name: 〜な (checking)
patterns.explanation: な at the end checks that the listener agrees, in a blunt male way. もってるな = 'you have them, right?'
